clue.text: Carriage lamp originally with gold

indicators.note: originally points to the opening letter of the word lamp

parts.note: with means and, joining things together
Au is the chemical symbol for gold

explanation.surface: An old coach lantern with gilded fittings.
explanation.definitionFit: A landau is a four-wheeled horse-drawn carriage with a folding top.

clue.text: Renting isn't a problem if obstinate

indicators.note: a problem suggests the letters of renting isn't a are in a mess and must be sorted out

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone stubborn insists letting out property poses no difficulty.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Renting isn't a problem' reads as one statement, but 'a' belongs to the fodder: RENTING ISN'T A (twelve letters, the apostrophe ignored) is rearranged under 'problem'.
explanation.definitionFit: Both describe someone who refuses to compromise or change their stance.

clue.text: Loneliness is love and joy, but without energy

parts.note: taken as written
love is zero in tennis scoring, the letter O

indicators.note: without tells us to take the energy letter out of the word for joy

parts.note: elation is great joy
E is the physics symbol for energy

explanation.surface: A gloomy line saying solitude is love and happiness, minus the vigour.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' removes E from ELATION, leaving LATION.
explanation.definitionFit: Isolation is the state of being cut off from others, which brings solitude.

clue.text: Advice to Spain to tread carefully

parts.note: a tip is a piece of advice
taken as written
E is the international vehicle registration code for Spain

explanation.surface: A warning to Spain to step with caution.
explanation.definitionFit: To move on the points of one's toes is to walk quietly and cautiously.

clue.text: Type of clue taking time ends in misunderstanding!

indicators.note: taking means the word for a clue type takes in the time letter

parts.note: crossword clues are either across or down
ends are aims or purposes, as in 'means to an end'

explanation.surface: A crossword joke: a kind of clue that takes its time ends in confusion.
explanation.walkthrough: 'taking' puts T inside ACROSS after its first letter, giving ATCROSS.
explanation.definitionFit: People at cross purposes are talking past each other, each mistaking what the other intends.

clue.text: Emphasises safety first with hair

indicators.note: first points to the opening letter of the word safety

parts.note: tresses are long locks of hair

explanation.surface: A hairdresser stresses safety first when styling.
explanation.definitionFit: To lay weight on something in speech is to emphasise it.

clue.text: Disheartened guard allowed primate in and yawned

indicators.note: allowed ... in means the outer letters let the primate inside them
disheartened means the word guard loses its heart, leaving only its first and last letters

parts.note: an ape is a primate

explanation.surface: A demoralised sentry let a monkey through and stood there open-mouthed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Disheartened' strips guard to G and D; 'allowed ... in' puts APE between them.
explanation.definitionFit: Both mean opened the mouth wide, gaping being a stare with jaw dropped.

clue.text: Dealing in ice, not in poison

indicators.note: dealing, as in dealing cards, shuffles the letters of in ice not

explanation.surface: Someone trafficking in ice rather than a toxic drug.
explanation.walkthrough: The anagram fodder is IN ICE NOT; the final 'in' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: Nicotine is a toxic alkaloid found in tobacco, used historically as an insecticide.

clue.text: Fingerprints expert left in Saigon

parts.note: a dab, or dab hand, is an expert

indicators.note: left in points to the leftmost letter of the word Saigon

explanation.surface: A forensic specialist abandoned in Vietnam's old capital.
explanation.walkthrough: 'left' looks like 'abandoned', but here it picks the left-hand letter of Saigon, an S.
explanation.definitionFit: Dabs is police slang for fingerprints.

clue.text: Hard top vehicle having a measure of speed

parts.note: a car is a vehicle
taken as written
pace is a rate of movement

explanation.surface: A hardtop car that can go at a good clip.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Hard top' looks like a type of car body, but it defines a shell.
explanation.definitionFit: A carapace is the hard upper shell of a turtle or crab.

clue.text: Tailored suit for a heathen?

indicators.note: suit as a verb means adapt or alter, so the letters of tailored are refitted

explanation.surface: A bespoke outfit fit for a pagan.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Tailored suit' reads as clothing, but 'suit' is the anagram signal working on TAILORED.
explanation.definitionFit: An idol-worshipper was traditionally regarded as a heathen or pagan.

clue.text: Before appointment, oddly she becomes calm

indicators.note: before places the odd letters ahead of the word for appointment
oddly picks the odd-numbered letters of the word she

parts.note: a date is an appointment

explanation.surface: Ahead of a meeting, a woman somehow settles down.
explanation.definitionFit: Sedate means composed and unhurried, quiet in manner.

clue.text: Projections on wall, however, need locks

parts.note: but means however
locks of hair are tresses

explanation.surface: Wall protrusions, yet they need hair?
explanation.definitionFit: Buttresses are supporting structures jutting from a wall.

clue.text: Finish fixing without starting!

indicators.note: without starting means the word for fixing drops its first letter

parts.note: mending is fixing or repairing

explanation.surface: Completing a repair without ever getting going.
explanation.definitionFit: An end or conclusion is a finish.

clue.text: Was up and reportedly intended to cause mischief

indicators.note: up in a down clue means the word is read from bottom to top

parts.note: lived means existed, or was

indicators.note: reportedly means as said aloud, so the sound of the word for intended is used

parts.note: meant means intended

explanation.surface: Someone awake and supposedly planning to make trouble.
explanation.walkthrough: 'up' turns LIVED into DEVIL; 'reportedly' turns MEANT into its sound-alike MENT.
explanation.definitionFit: Devilment is playful wickedness, roguish behaviour.

clue.text: Persistent objections are raised and carried

indicators.note: raised in a down clue means the word is turned to read upwards

parts.note: buts are objections, as in 'no ifs or buts'
born is a form of the past participle of bear, to carry

explanation.surface: Ongoing complaints are voiced and endured.
explanation.walkthrough: 'raised' turns BUTS into STUB.
explanation.definitionFit: A stubborn person persists doggedly and refuses to give way.

clue.text: Manages to find room, sending leader to the rear

indicators.note: the front letter of the word for room is moved to the end

parts.note: scope is room, as in room for manoeuvre

explanation.surface: A team boss finds space by moving the captain to the back.
explanation.definitionFit: Copes means gets by or deals successfully with difficulties.

clue.text: Do screen plays get suppressed?

indicators.note: plays, as in plays about or frolics, sets the letters of do screen moving

explanation.surface: Asking whether films shown on screen get cut by the authorities.
explanation.walkthrough: 'screen plays' reads as screenplays, but 'plays' is the anagram signal working on DO SCREEN.
explanation.definitionFit: Material that has been censored has been suppressed by an official.

clue.text: A note designed to protect copyright straight away

indicators.note: to protect means the rearranged letters wrap round the copyright letter
designed means the letters of a note are planned out afresh in a new order

parts.note: C is the copyright symbol

explanation.surface: A notice drafted to safeguard copyright immediately.
explanation.walkthrough: 'designed' rearranges A NOTE into ATONE, and 'to protect' puts C inside it after the first three letters.
explanation.definitionFit: At once means immediately, without delay.

clue.text: Tales of a clergyman eaten by indigenous people

indicators.note: eaten by means the word for indigenous people swallows a and the clergyman

parts.note: natives are the indigenous people of a place
taken as written
RR stands for Right Reverend, a bishop's title

explanation.surface: Stories of a missionary devoured by locals.
explanation.walkthrough: 'eaten by' puts ARR inside NATIVES after the first letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Narratives are stories, accounts of events.

clue.text: Get used to a m-melody

parts.note: taken as written
the stammered start of m-melody asks for a stammered tune, its first letter repeated

explanation.surface: Someone stammering while trying to adjust to a tune.
explanation.walkthrough: The stutter on 'm-melody' is the device: melody means TUNE, and the stammer doubles its first letter.
explanation.definitionFit: To attune oneself is to adjust or acclimatise to something.

clue.text: Substitute held by players at Zurich

indicators.note: held by means the letters are contained within the words players at Zurich

explanation.surface: A replacement kept on by a team in Switzerland.
explanation.definitionFit: Ersatz describes an inferior substitute or imitation.

clue.text: Buildings in which a busy worker's heard?

indicators.note: heard means the phrase is said aloud and the spelling follows its sound

parts.note: a gives A; a bee is the proverbial busy worker, so busy worker's gives bee's

explanation.surface: Asking where an industrious labourer can be heard working.
explanation.walkthrough: 'busy worker' is a bee, as in 'busy as a bee'; 'a bee's' said aloud gives the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Abbeys are monastic churches and the buildings around them.

clue.text: Actor's rising skill supports old flame

indicators.note: supports in a down clue means the second piece sits beneath the first

parts.note: an ex is a former partner or old flame

indicators.note: rising in a down clue means the word for skill reads upwards

parts.note: art is skill

explanation.surface: A performer's growing talent props up a former lover.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Actor's' looks possessive, but the definition is the actor; 'supports' works because in a down answer the lower piece holds up the upper one.
explanation.definitionFit: A walk-on performer in a film crowd scene is a non-speaking bit player.

clue.text: Work time is flexible, so make best use of it

parts.note: op, short for opus, is a work

indicators.note: flexible means the letters of time is can be bent into a new shape

explanation.surface: Flexitime advice: arrange your hours to get the most out of them.
explanation.walkthrough: 'flexible' rearranges TIME IS into TIMISE.
explanation.definitionFit: To optimise is to get the most effective result from something.

clue.text: Attitudes sure to develop on the job

indicators.note: on in an across clue places the rearranged letters after the word for job

parts.note: a post is a job

indicators.note: to develop means the letters of sure grow into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: Workplace attitudes are certain to form once you are employed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to develop' turns SURE into URES.
explanation.definitionFit: Postures are stances or positions taken on an issue.

clue.text: Bill backing educational establishment

indicators.note: backing means the word for the school is read backwards

parts.note: Eton is the famous English public school near Windsor

explanation.surface: An invoice supporting a school.
explanation.walkthrough: 'backing' looks like financial support but turns ETON round; ETON is a famous English boarding school.
explanation.definitionFit: A banknote is a bill in American usage.

clue.text: Burning money in America on dances in fashion

indicators.note: on in an across clue places the remade letters before the coin
fashion as a verb means shape or form, so the letters of dances in are remade

parts.note: a cent is a coin in American money

explanation.surface: Throwing away dollars on trendy dancing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in fashion' reads as trendy, but 'fashion' rearranges DANCES IN to INCANDES.
explanation.definitionFit: Incandescent means glowing with heat, aflame.
